transcript.text: As soon as you hit whatever your rock
bottom is, you can ask yourself, how can
I let this bad thing serve me? So, if
you were the main character in a movie
and the character gets passed up for the
promotion, doesn't get the girl, you
know, the person they cared about most
died, what would the character in the
story do to move the plot along to get
the happy ending? As soon as you
recognize what that character would do
or what what worldview would have to
exist, then do it. No matter how bad it
is, our moments of greatest growth
typically come after our biggest upsets.
